title: A Couple of Cuckoos
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nagi Umino learns he was switched at birth, and his biological parents and adoptive parents decide he should marry Erika Amano, the girl raised in his place (to verify). The two move in together while each pursues someone else, including Nagi's crush Hiro and his adoptive sister Sachi, in a love-triangle comedy by Miki Yoshikawa (to verify).
life_message: It holds up family, whether by blood or upbringing, and choosing love honestly.
